STRUCT_LAYOUT.MATH: 5 public 4-byte fields = 20 bytes; 3 private 4-byte pads = 12 bytes; total = 32 bytes; 32 mod 8 = 0; 32 mod 16 = 0; 2 rows fit exactly in one 64-byte L1 cache line.

SELF_AUDIT.SCALABILITY_CURVE: GlobalQualityWeight is continuous. Below 0.3 the solver stretches cadence toward 1.0s with math.lerp while accumulating dt so authority stress remains conserved. Visual and acoustic presentation use smooth/lerped scalars and lower publish cadence; no binary low/high branch changes DTO identity, suit failure truth, damage route, or save identity. High and ultra tiers spend the same scalar payload on shader/HUD/audio detail instead of CPU mesh deformation.
